build_pytorchvideo_package: build a source distribution for the pytorchvideo package using python setup.py sdist
build_nightly_package: build a nightly wheel by running BUILD_NIGHTLY=1 python setup.py sdist
get_version_pytorchvideo: get the current version string from pytorchvideo __init__.py using the get_version function
get_name_pytorchvideo: get the package name for pytorchvideo or pytorchvideo-nightly using the get_name function
review_setup_dependencies: review the install_requires and extras_require dependencies in the pytorchvideo setup.py file
